Print a score_diff_path object

Source: R/api-scores-diff.R
print.score_diff_path.Rd

Print a score_diff_path object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'score_diff_path'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A score_diff_path object created by score_diff_path().

...

Not used.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

sc <- new_score(
  name = "order1",
  order = 1L,
  eval_param = function(idxs, data, theta, ctx, rng) theta[1] * data[idxs]
)
print(score_diff_path(sc, data = c(1, 2, 3)))
#> <score_diff_path>
#>   score : order1
#>   grad  : auto
#>   fd    : step=1e-06, scheme=central
